title: Fantastic Pretraining Optimizers and Where to Find Them II: Hyperball Optimization
abstract: arXiv:2606.16899v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Matrix based optimizers such as Muon can substantially speed up language model pretraining, but their gains over AdamW are observed to shrink as model size and data scale grow when using standard constant decoupled weight decay. We propose Hyperball, a simple optimizer wrapper that addresses this issue. Given a base optimizer such as Adam or Muon, Hyperball sets the Frobenius norms of weight matrices and their corresponding optimizer updates to fixed constants. On Qwen3 style models up to 1.2B parameters, Muon Hyperball achieves 20--30% token equivalent speedup over weight decay baselines. Hyperball also improves learning rate transfer across widths and depths compared to decoupled weight decay. This method is motivated by prior theory showing that training with weight decay leads to an equilibrium weight norm that only depends on the training hyperparameters. Through this mechanism, the weight decay then decides the angular learning

translated_title: 神奇的预训练优化器及其寻找之地 II：Hyperball 优化
translated_abstract: 基于矩阵的优化器（如 Muon）能够显著加速语言模型预训练，但研究发现，在使用标准恒定解耦权重衰减时，随着模型规模和数据规模的增长，它们相对 AdamW 的优势会逐渐缩小。我们提出了 Hyperball，一个解决该问题的简单优化器包装器。给定一个基础优化器（如 Adam 或 Muon），Hyperball 将权重矩阵的 Frobenius 范数及其对应的优化器更新设置为固定常数。在最大 12 亿参数的 Qwen3 风格模型上，Muon Hyperball 相比权重衰减基线实现了 20%-30% 的等效 token 加速。与解耦权重衰减相比，Hyperball 还改善了学习率在不同宽度和深度模型之间的迁移。该方法的灵感来自先前的理论，即使用权重衰减训练会导致平衡权重范数仅取决于训练超参数；通过这一机制，权重衰减进而决定了角向学习率。
tldr: 提出 Hyperball 优化器包装器，通过将权重矩阵及其更新的 Frobenius 范数固定为常数，使 Muon 在大规模模型上相对 AdamW 权重衰减基线获得 20%-30% 的等效 token 加速，并改善学习率跨模型宽度和深度的迁移能力。
en_tdlr: Hyperball, a simple optimizer wrapper that fixes the Frobenius norms of weight matrices and their updates to constants, enables Muon to achieve 20-30% token-equivalent speedup over AdamW weight decay baselines at scale, while also improving learning rate transfer across model widths and depths.
